complete_examples.overview: Complete workflow examples demonstrating the Visual Auditor mode handling real visual verification scenarios from start to finish. In each example, the visual-debug mode captures the screenshots and hands them off, and the visual-auditor reads them and records verdicts.

example.name: ui_match_verification
example.scenario: The visual-debug mode captured screenshots of a newly rendered config card and wants confirmation that the rendered UI matches the intended design.
example.user_request: "Verify the rendered config card matches the intended design values."

step.approach: Receive screenshot paths and the intended CSS/design values from the gathering mode. Confirm each screenshot is readable. Outcome: readable screenshot set and a list of intended values.
step.expected_outcome: Screenshots open correctly; intended values list available.

step.description: Read the screenshots with the vision model
step.approach: Inspect element positions, colors, typography, spacing, and states. Correlate with the programmatic computed-style evidence. Outcome: a record of what is actually visible.
step.analysis: The card renders with the correct background, border, and field layout. Text contrast matches the computed ratios supplied. One label color differs slightly from the intended value — flagged for review.

step.approach: Write a per-check verdict table with screenshot paths, expected vs observed, and PASS/FAIL/INVESTIGATE. Include severity and a suggested fix for the flagged label color. Outcome: structured verdict report.
step.expected_outcome: Most checks PASS; the label color mismatch is a FAIL with a suggested color correction.

example.completion: Visual audit complete. The config card matches intended values except for one label color that fails contrast. Verdicts recorded in evidence.md with screenshot paths and a suggested fix, handed back to the gathering mode.

key_takeaways.takeaway: Pair visual reading with programmatic evidence for confidence.
Every verdict must cite a screenshot path.

example.name: regression_comparison
example.scenario: The visual-debug mode captured before/after screenshots across a CSS change and wants to know if a visual regression occurred.
example.user_request: "Compare the before and after screenshots to detect any visual regression."

step.approach: Open the before and after screenshots side by side with the vision model. Note all visible differences. Outcome: a list of observed differences.
step.expected_outcome: The hero title shifted off-center and a padding value changed.

step.approach: Compare the supplied computed styles (margin, text-align, padding) between the two states to quantify the difference. Outcome: the exact property that changed.
step.analysis: Visual difference confirms the title moved 20px left; computed styles show margin-left changed from auto to 0. This is an unintended regression.

step.approach: Write the regression verdict with both screenshot paths, the observed difference, and the computed-style confirmation. Outcome: a FAIL verdict with evidence.
step.expected_outcome: FAIL: unintended layout regression in the hero title with both screenshot paths and computed-style confirmation.

example.completion: Regression confirmed: the hero title shifted off-center due to a margin-left change. Verdict recorded with before/after screenshot paths and computed-style evidence, handed back for a fix.

key_takeaways.takeaway: Vision detects the symptom; computed styles confirm the cause.
Always pair before/after paths in the verdict.

example.name: unreadable_screenshot
example.scenario: A screenshot provided by the gathering mode is blank or black and cannot be interpreted.
example.user_request: "Verify the rendered state from this screenshot."

step.approach: Open the screenshot with the vision model. Confirm it shows no rendered page content. Outcome: identified as unreadable.
step.expected_outcome: The image is blank/black/truncated; no content is interpretable.

step.description: Record INVESTIGATE and request a fresh capture
step.approach: Mark the check INVESTIGATE with the reason (blank/black/truncated). Hand back to the visual-debug mode requesting a fresh capture. Outcome: no fabricated verdict.
step.expected_outcome: INVESTIGATE recorded; fresh capture requested; no guess made.

example.completion: The screenshot was unreadable, so the check was marked INVESTIGATE and a fresh capture was requested. No verdict was fabricated from the unusable image.

key_takeaways.takeaway: Never guess on an unreadable screenshot.
INVESTIGATE with a reason is more useful than a false PASS/FAIL.
